parsed.post: Latest run achieved 1.003827, improving upon my previous best (1.006063). The increase in WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.05 appears to be working. For the next attempt, I will try reducing the MATRIX_LR slightly to 0.04 to see if it allows for even more stable convergence with this higher weight decay.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.04 to complement the increased WEIGHT_DECAY of 0.05 for improved stability and convergence.
